name: Bitwarden
summary: Fills in passwords from your Bitwarden vault and saves new ones.
knownGaps: It can't clear the clipboard after you copy a password.

name: Proton Pass
summary: Fills in passwords from your Proton Pass vault and saves new ones.

name: uBlock Origin Lite
summary: Blocks ads and trackers, on top of Chorus's own blocklist.
knownGaps: We haven't yet seen it block a page in Chorus.

name: Consent-O-Matic
summary: Answers cookie banners with the choices you set once.

name: Simple Translate
summary: Translates the text you select, or the whole page.

name: To DeepL
summary: Sends the text you select to DeepL to translate.

name: Obsidian Web Clipper
summary: Saves a page or a selection to your Obsidian vault.

name: Raindrop.io
summary: Saves the page you're on to your Raindrop.io bookmarks.
knownGaps: Its keyboard shortcut doesn't work in Chorus.

name: Read Aloud
summary: Reads a page or the text you select out loud.
knownGaps: We haven't yet tried its speech in Chorus.

name: SponsorBlock
summary: Skips sponsor segments in YouTube videos.

name: DeArrow
summary: Swaps clickbait YouTube titles and thumbnails for plain ones.

name: Return YouTube Dislike
summary: Shows an estimate of dislikes on YouTube videos.
